posts.author: DecentTreatment
posts.body: Lilith Zone (AKA Cicada Marionette) shook the medium with CRYPT WORLDS, perhaps the most influential art game of the 2010s.  Weird, surreal, queer-- it was something entirely new. In this rare long-form conversation, she talks about her creative philosophy, surrealism, and the strange beauty of liminal spaces.

posts.author: DecentTreatment
posts.body:
NEW INTERVIEW:
Kasey Ozymy is an Austin, Texas-based game designer, composer, and creator of JIMMY & THE PULSATING MASS. His goal is to make story-centric role-playing games that draw heavily from the best design ideas from SNES and PSX era RPGs while elevating them with exciting new gameplay ideas. Most recently, he released the console definitive version of Jimmy and successfully kickstarted a new game Hymn to the Earless God!
Appreciate you, forum folks!

posts.author: DecentTreatment
posts.body: BadAlias is a freeware game developer and illustrator. Most known for his dark fantasy experience Moon River, this up-and-coming auteur likes to challenge themself by using old programs like MS Paint and RPG Maker. They are working with host Decent Treatment (me hehe) on a new frigid corpse game THERMOCLINE. Their work can also be found in NoteDream, a collaborative Yume Nikki fangame project.

posts.author: DecentTreatment
posts.body: John Thyer AKA farawaytimes is a freeware game developer and blogger-critic. Most known for his experimental RPG Maker game 'Facets', this community organizer likes to challenge themself by using 'opinionated media' like bitsy and RPG Maker. They are associated with underground art-game communities like Domino Club, 'Socks' and Vextro. Most recently, they hosted the 'Cookie Cutter RM2K3 Jam'!

posts.author: DecentTreatment
posts.body: DECENT TREATMENT (me) makes horror games, visual art, and many other things! You probably know them as host of the Electric Airship Interview series. In 2024, they led team SEMICOLON in releasing a psychological thriller about Amazonian river dolphins called BLOOD ORANGE. The band is back together now for their survival horror jrpg THERMOCLINE, coming winter 2026.  But that's not all-- their opus-to-date THRONE: FINAL TWILIGHT, a punishing dark fantasy RPG, is coming soon after Thermocline's PC release.
